name: amethyst/bracket-lib
description: The Roguelike Toolkit (RLTK) implemented for Rust, providing pathfinding (A* and Dijkstra), noise generation, color management, and multiple rendering backends including OpenGL, WebGPU, and terminal. Companion to the popular 'Roguelike Tutorial in Rust' book.
score_rationale: 1.7k-star Rust roguelike toolkit that is the standard starting point for Rust roguelike development, with comprehensive tutorials.
summary: Rust roguelike toolkit with pathfinding, noise, and multi-backend rendering support
